markdown: **Activate** <actions string="" /> envision (daily preparations);     **Effect** When you perform your daily preparations, you can share the _Deck of Destiny_ with your companions, allowing them to invest a hand of up to 5 cards each as if they carried the cards. When one of your companions activates one of their invested cards, an illusory image of the card appears in their hand, but the card's effects are otherwise unaltered. This lasts until the next time you perform your daily preparations.
